# Trimex Office AU Tower

> This office occupies level 34 of AU Tower, a 35-storey commercial tower in Cluster I of Jumeirah Lakes Towers, Dubai. Completed in 2009 and named after the chemical symbol for gold, the building was conceived for precious metals and commodities trading firms. It stands in a free-zone business district of around 80 towers arranged around landscaped lakes, and the suite houses the Dubai office of the Trimex Group.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Jumeirah Lakes Towers, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

This office for Trimex Group occupies level 34 of Gold Tower, also known as AU Tower, a commercial high-rise in Cluster I of Jumeirah Lake Towers, Dubai. MENASCO executed the air-conditioning and electrical works for the office for BBR. The project reflects MENASCO's experience in delivering building services for corporate office interiors within Dubai's high-rise business districts.
